name: Fire Style: Great Fireball Jutsu
desc: Chakra kneaded in the chest is exhaled as one huge rolling sphere of flame. A rite of passage for the Uchiha clan.
tip: Breathe in on Horse, hold Tiger like you are about to blow out a giant candle.

name: Fire Style: Phoenix Sage Fire Jutsu
desc: A spray of small fireballs spits out in a fan, each one steering on its own so the target cannot dodge them all.
tip: Tiger appears twice: release the first one fully before forming it again.

name: Fire Style: Dragon Flame Jutsu
desc: A tight line of flame races forward like a burning fuse, often guided along wire straight to a trapped foe.
tip: Short and quick: four signs, then aim the flame along an imaginary wire.

name: Fire Style: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet
desc: A serpent of fire coils out of the mouth and lunges at the target, its body trailing a long wake of flame.
tip: Seven signs ending on Tiger; take a deep breath before the last one.

name: Fire Style: Ash Pile Burning
desc: A cloud of chakra-laced ash is blown over the enemy, then a click of the teeth sets the whole cloud ablaze.
tip: Drop your hands between the two Snakes so the second one counts.

name: Amaterasu
desc: Black flames ignite wherever the eye focuses. They burn for days and cannot be put out by water.
tip: Canon needs no seals, only a Mangekyō stare; stare hard at one spot after Tiger.

name: Blaze Style: Kagutsuchi
desc: Black flames are shaped at will, here raised into a wall of jagged fire that shields the caster.
tip: Canon has no seals; it is pure eye control of black fire.

name: Wind Style: Great Breakthrough
desc: A violent blast of wind is exhaled or pushed out, flattening trees and blowing enemies off their feet.
tip: End on Snake, then thrust both palms forward to push the gust out.

name: Wind Style: Vacuum Sphere
desc: Rapid-fire vacuum bullets are spat out one after another, each one a tiny pocket of cutting air.
tip: Only three signs: Rat, Hare, Dog. Hold Dog and puff your cheeks for the volley.

name: Wind Style: Sickle Weasel Jutsu
desc: One swing of a giant fan whips up a gust full of invisible blades that shreds whatever it passes.
tip: Finish on Bird and swing your arm wide like a fan.

name: Wind Style: Wind Cutter Jutsu
desc: A thin, sharp slice of wind is flung forward to cut through ropes, wood or armor at range.
tip: Finish on Dragon and slice one hand sideways like a blade.

name: Chidori
desc: Lightning chakra gathers in one hand with a sound like a thousand chirping birds, then the user charges for a piercing thrust.
tip: After Monkey, grip your wrist and keep the open hand pointed down.

name: Lightning Blade
desc: A refined, denser Chidori said to have once cut a bolt of lightning in half.
tip: Canon uses the same seals as Chidori; Dog was added to tell them apart.

name: Chidori Sharp Spear
desc: The Chidori is stretched into a long blade of lightning that stabs at range.
tip: Canon has no seals; thrust the hand forward after Dragon.

name: Lightning Style: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang
desc: Lightning in the hand takes the form of a hound that sprints at the target and follows if it dodges.
tip: Dog first for the hound, then the Chidori trio.

name: Kirin
desc: Natural lightning from storm clouds heated by fire is pulled down in the shape of a beast. It strikes far too fast to dodge.
tip: Canon needs no seals, only a raised arm; point at the sky, then bring it down.
